data.name: memu is space cat
data.detailed_description:
Drift with memu, through a slightly strange universe.

The space cat memu floats through a wondrous, neon-soaked universe. Neon grids, a melting sun, shapes you can't even begin to name. It's way too much information — so much that your brain just gives up trying to process it.

So much chaos, somehow cozy. And wait — what even is a space cat?

◆ Bathe in the sights and sounds

Leave it be and memu drifts on its own. You can just watch. Dazzling scenery, strange music. Space out, and just soak it in. Feel like it? Take the wheel, pull up to a planet, snap a photo. Don't feel like it? Do nothing. That's fine too.

◆ Every time, the music and the space are brand new

Planets, pockets, ruins of no known purpose. Roam places scattered at random. Sky, color, shapes, and the music playing — all freshly generated, every time. The same view, the same track, never comes again. Today's universe is today's only.

◆ Two ways to play

Pick by mood. Neither one can kill you. Neither one rushes you.

  • Drift — the leave-it-on one. Launch it, walk away. Its whole job is to run in the background — sights and sounds like a BGM behind your work.
  • Journey — the actually-play one. Tilt a whole star and roll memu around inside it. Wind down a course grabbing cat cans to the goal. Fall off? A ramp right there rolls you back on.

◆ Bookmark the ones you like

The same universe never comes back. Pull a weird one and you can show it off to friends. Or just keep it to yourself. Your "huh, I kinda like this" collection slowly piles up.

◆ Grab a cat can, if you want

There are cat cans lying around. Pick them up, or drift right past. There's nothing in this universe you have to do.

◆ Loose achievements fill in on their own

No rush. No failing. Drift, roll, find things, grab the odd can — and somehow it's filling up.

No goal. No hurry. Watch it, or roll it. Just melt your brain in a weird space, with weird sounds.

data.short_description: The space cat memu just drifts through dazzling sights and music. Every time, the music and the space are freshly generated — just space out and watch. 'Drift' mode: leave it on like a BGM. 'Journey' mode: tilt a star and roll memu around inside. Sink into the unknown — in a universe you like, in the mode you like. — Background for work.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
